title: Birthday Gift Prep Lead Time
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:spend
| search lead_time_days=*
| stats avg(lead_time_days) as avg_lead_time_days perc90(lead_time_days) as p90_lead_time_days count as samples by recipient_group
| sort 0 - avg_lead_time_days
description: Measures birthday gift prep lead time by recipient group.
value: Lead time reveals whether gifts are being planned thoughtfully or rescued at the last second.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for birthday gift prep lead time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 birthday gift prep lead time.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how long birthday gift prep lead time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
